payload.name: Both Ends
payload.description: This ability has two flavours. The first will be signified by the normal weapon, raised. It will create a medium AoE around Qitian Dasheng. Getting hit by this AoE will knock the player back into the bluish outer ring. This debuff area will apply Bleeding and one (1) stack of Vulnerability Up. The second will be signified by an enlarged weapon with electric current on it, lowered. It will do the same, but with a safe zone near Qitian Dasheng. In short: Normal weapon - stay away from the boss. Enlarged, electrified weapon - stay near the boss.
